dashboard.label: Demo Talk Track
dashboard.description: 25–30 minute demo script for ServiceNow + ES Mission Control linkage.

div.h1: ServiceNow + Splunk ES Mission Control Demo
div.p: Duration: 25-30 min | Time range: Last 30 days | Audience: SOC, IT leadership, ES evaluators

div.div: Pre-demo: Load data, enable MC alerts/detections, set Last 30 days on all dashboards.

div.p: A regional financial institution runs dual SOC queues (SOC 1 and SOC 2). Mission Control surfaces findings; ServiceNow tracks remediation; Splunk links both.

div.div: "Today I'll show how Splunk ES Mission Control and ServiceNow work together for case management. We detect in ES, triage in Mission Control, and remediate in ServiceNow — with Splunk linking both so analysts don't swivel-chair between tools."
div.p: Key message: Detect → Triage → Remediate → Report

div.div: "This demo uses a portable Splunk app with synthetic ServiceNow incidents, CMDB assets, and ES/Mission Control source events in dedicated demo indexes."
index IN (demo_servicenow, demo_security) OR index=notable | stats count by index sourcetype | sort index

div.h2: Act 3 — Mission Control analyst queue (8 min)
div.p: Screen: ES → Mission Control → Analyst queue
div.div: "Analysts start in Mission Control. Findings from correlation searches and detections appear here for triage, assignment, and investigation."
"Each finding ties back to a ServiceNow INC and notable ID so we know which ITSM ticket owns remediation."
div.p: Open one finding — highlight title, urgency, owner, entity/risk object, snow_incident_number, soc_queue.

div.div: "While Mission Control is the analyst triage console, ServiceNow remains the system of record for ITSM."

tr.td: Findings in index=notable from demo alerts
Distinct ServiceNow cases in ES source data

div.p: Drill into an INC — show u_splunk_notable_event_id, u_splunk_correlation_search, MITRE fields, cmdb_ci, business_service.
Screen: SOC Case Management → Mission Control Findings Linked to ServiceNow INCs
div.div: "This table shows how Mission Control findings, ES source events, and ServiceNow INCs connect. When linkage shows 'Mission Control + ServiceNow', analysts trust triage in ES and remediation in ServiceNow refer to the same incident."
div.p: Also show: Mission Control Notable Events panel and SOC Queue pie chart.
Screen: Daily Case Trend, Workflow State, Assets with Case Activity
div.div: "Leadership cares about trends — daily volume, workflow stalls, and which CIs drive the most case activity."

"Splunk ES Mission Control gives analysts a unified queue. ServiceNow remains ITSM system of record. Splunk links both with notable IDs, INC numbers, MITRE context, and asset metadata — detect, triage, and remediate as one workflow."
